chain_lightning.doc: chain lightning on/off for the quest run

chronofield.doc: chronofield on/off for the quest run

death_wave.doc: death wave on/off for the quest run

golden_tower.doc: golden tower on/off for the quest run

inner_land_mines.doc: inner land mines on/off for the quest run

poison_swamp.doc: poison swamp on/off for the quest run

smart_missiles.doc: smart missiles on/off for the quest run

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

after.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window opens; omit for 'from midnight'

block.doc: what the scheduler thinks it is launching (or any `quest*` name for the quest runners) - it is checked against the blueprint's kind

count.doc: runs of this block per day, persisted per block id so an aborted day resumes. A tournament block is 1 and cannot be raised

bar_names.doc: the two bars a rule can watch

after.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window opens; omit for 'from midnight'

block.doc: what the scheduler thinks it is launching (or any `quest*` name for the quest runners) - it is checked against the blueprint's kind

count.doc: runs of this block per day, persisted per block id so an aborted day resumes. A tournament block is 1 and cannot be raised

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

bar_names.doc: the two bars a rule can watch

after.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window opens; omit for 'from midnight'

block.doc: what the scheduler thinks it is launching (or any `quest*` name for the quest runners) - it is checked against the blueprint's kind

blueprint.doc: a key from this profile's `blueprints` section

count.doc: runs of this block per day, persisted per block id so an aborted day resumes. A tournament block is 1 and cannot be raised

until.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window closes; omit for 'rest of the day'. A block that runs past midnight belongs to both days, so write it in both

blueprint_fields.doc: the legal source fields of a blueprint, PER KIND - every field the validator accepts for that kind and no field it refuses

automation.doc: Per-run boolean routine gates; omitted gates retain existing defaults

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint once at run start - it LOCKS THE ABILITY ROW, so a rescue that needs abilities from wave 1 says so here

dissonant_tab.doc: Dissonance: enter runs via the Dissonant Run dialog with this workshop tab disabled, instead of the BATTLE button. Unstated (null) is a normal run. Shopping on the disabled tab is compiled out; ultimate_weapons also compiles the weapon toggles out. Needs the dialog images for that tab

global_behaviors.doc: Per-run reward settings overriding shared global behaviors

kind.doc: which runner drives this blueprint - it is also the key this section is grouped under

label.doc: what the tray and the run log call it; defaults to the blueprint name, title-cased

loadout.doc: a `config.yaml` loadouts key, or `as_is` to equip nothing (coin only). REQUIRED - an omitted loadout is a forgotten one, which is why it is refused

max_wave.doc: surrender at this wave, through the guarded exit flow. Unstated (null) is NO CAP, and one attempt per run

perk_bans.doc: perks to keep BANNED while this run type plays, as fragments of the perk's own wording (numbers are ignored: 'coins, but tower max health'). Set on the Home Perks dialog before each entry when it differs from what was last applied. Unstated (null) never opens the dialog; [] clears every ban

policies.doc: which named policies this blueprint runs under

restart_via_home.doc: go back to the home screen between runs (where the between-run chores live) instead of straight to RETRY

shop_interval_sec.doc: how often the workshop sweep may run, in seconds

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

cycle_sec.doc: one cycle of the quest loop - seconds, greater than 0

reroll_at_wave.doc: reroll the quest at this wave

uw_setup.doc: which ultimate weapons the quest run switches on before it starts; a weapon the account does not own cannot be switched on

black_hole.doc: black hole on/off for the quest run

chain_lightning.doc: chain lightning on/off for the quest run

chronofield.doc: chronofield on/off for the quest run

death_wave.doc: death wave on/off for the quest run

golden_tower.doc: golden tower on/off for the quest run

inner_land_mines.doc: inner land mines on/off for the quest run

poison_swamp.doc: poison swamp on/off for the quest run

smart_missiles.doc: smart missiles on/off for the quest run

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

bar_names.doc: the two bars a rule can watch

after.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window opens; omit for 'from midnight'

block.doc: what the scheduler thinks it is launching (or any `quest*` name for the quest runners) - it is checked against the blueprint's kind

blueprint.doc: a key from this profile's `blueprints` section

count.doc: runs of this block per day, persisted per block id so an aborted day resumes. A tournament block is 1 and cannot be raised

until.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window closes; omit for 'rest of the day'. A block that runs past midnight belongs to both days, so write it in both

blueprint_fields.doc: the legal source fields of a blueprint, PER KIND - every field the validator accepts for that kind and no field it refuses

automation.doc: Per-run boolean routine gates; omitted gates retain existing defaults

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint once at run start - it LOCKS THE ABILITY ROW, so a rescue that needs abilities from wave 1 says so here

dissonant_tab.doc: Dissonance: enter runs via the Dissonant Run dialog with this workshop tab disabled, instead of the BATTLE button. Unstated (null) is a normal run. Shopping on the disabled tab is compiled out; ultimate_weapons also compiles the weapon toggles out. Needs the dialog images for that tab

global_behaviors.doc: Per-run reward settings overriding shared global behaviors

kind.doc: which runner drives this blueprint - it is also the key this section is grouped under

label.doc: what the tray and the run log call it; defaults to the blueprint name, title-cased

loadout.doc: a `config.yaml` loadouts key, or `as_is` to equip nothing (coin only). REQUIRED - an omitted loadout is a forgotten one, which is why it is refused

max_wave.doc: surrender at this wave, through the guarded exit flow. Unstated (null) is NO CAP, and one attempt per run

perk_bans.doc: perks to keep BANNED while this run type plays, as fragments of the perk's own wording (numbers are ignored: 'coins, but tower max health'). Set on the Home Perks dialog before each entry when it differs from what was last applied. Unstated (null) never opens the dialog; [] clears every ban

policies.doc: which named policies this blueprint runs under

restart_via_home.doc: go back to the home screen between runs (where the between-run chores live) instead of straight to RETRY

shop_interval_sec.doc: how often the workshop sweep may run, in seconds

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

cycle_sec.doc: one cycle of the quest loop - seconds, greater than 0

reroll_at_wave.doc: reroll the quest at this wave

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

uw_setup.doc: which ultimate weapons the quest run switches on before it starts; a weapon the account does not own cannot be switched on

black_hole.doc: black hole on/off for the quest run

chain_lightning.doc: chain lightning on/off for the quest run

chronofield.doc: chronofield on/off for the quest run

death_wave.doc: death wave on/off for the quest run

golden_tower.doc: golden tower on/off for the quest run

inner_land_mines.doc: inner land mines on/off for the quest run

poison_swamp.doc: poison swamp on/off for the quest run

smart_missiles.doc: smart missiles on/off for the quest run

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

bar_names.doc: the two bars a rule can watch

after.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window opens; omit for 'from midnight'

block.doc: what the scheduler thinks it is launching (or any `quest*` name for the quest runners) - it is checked against the blueprint's kind

blueprint.doc: a key from this profile's `blueprints` section

count.doc: runs of this block per day, persisted per block id so an aborted day resumes. A tournament block is 1 and cannot be raised

until.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window closes; omit for 'rest of the day'. A block that runs past midnight belongs to both days, so write it in both

blueprint_fields.doc: the legal source fields of a blueprint, PER KIND - every field the validator accepts for that kind and no field it refuses

automation.doc: Per-run boolean routine gates; omitted gates retain existing defaults

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint once at run start - it LOCKS THE ABILITY ROW, so a rescue that needs abilities from wave 1 says so here

dissonant_tab.doc: Dissonance: enter runs via the Dissonant Run dialog with this workshop tab disabled, instead of the BATTLE button. Unstated (null) is a normal run. Shopping on the disabled tab is compiled out; ultimate_weapons also compiles the weapon toggles out. Needs the dialog images for that tab

global_behaviors.doc: Per-run reward settings overriding shared global behaviors

kind.doc: which runner drives this blueprint - it is also the key this section is grouped under

label.doc: what the tray and the run log call it; defaults to the blueprint name, title-cased

loadout.doc: a `config.yaml` loadouts key, or `as_is` to equip nothing (coin only). REQUIRED - an omitted loadout is a forgotten one, which is why it is refused

max_wave.doc: surrender at this wave, through the guarded exit flow. Unstated (null) is NO CAP, and one attempt per run

perk_bans.doc: perks to keep BANNED while this run type plays, as fragments of the perk's own wording (numbers are ignored: 'coins, but tower max health'). Set on the Home Perks dialog before each entry when it differs from what was last applied. Unstated (null) never opens the dialog; [] clears every ban

policies.doc: which named policies this blueprint runs under

restart_via_home.doc: go back to the home screen between runs (where the between-run chores live) instead of straight to RETRY

shop_interval_sec.doc: how often the workshop sweep may run, in seconds

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

cycle_sec.doc: one cycle of the quest loop - seconds, greater than 0

reroll_at_wave.doc: reroll the quest at this wave

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

uw_setup.doc: which ultimate weapons the quest run switches on before it starts; a weapon the account does not own cannot be switched on

black_hole.doc: black hole on/off for the quest run

chain_lightning.doc: chain lightning on/off for the quest run

chronofield.doc: chronofield on/off for the quest run

death_wave.doc: death wave on/off for the quest run

golden_tower.doc: golden tower on/off for the quest run

inner_land_mines.doc: inner land mines on/off for the quest run

poison_swamp.doc: poison swamp on/off for the quest run

smart_missiles.doc: smart missiles on/off for the quest run

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

until.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window closes; omit for 'rest of the day'. A block that runs past midnight belongs to both days, so write it in both

blueprint_fields.doc: the legal source fields of a blueprint, PER KIND - every field the validator accepts for that kind and no field it refuses

automation.doc: Per-run boolean routine gates; omitted gates retain existing defaults

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint once at run start - it LOCKS THE ABILITY ROW, so a rescue that needs abilities from wave 1 says so here

dissonant_tab.doc: Dissonance: enter runs via the Dissonant Run dialog with this workshop tab disabled, instead of the BATTLE button. Unstated (null) is a normal run. Shopping on the disabled tab is compiled out; ultimate_weapons also compiles the weapon toggles out. Needs the dialog images for that tab

global_behaviors.doc: Per-run reward settings overriding shared global behaviors

kind.doc: which runner drives this blueprint - it is also the key this section is grouped under

label.doc: what the tray and the run log call it; defaults to the blueprint name, title-cased

loadout.doc: a `config.yaml` loadouts key, or `as_is` to equip nothing (coin only). REQUIRED - an omitted loadout is a forgotten one, which is why it is refused

max_wave.doc: surrender at this wave, through the guarded exit flow. Unstated (null) is NO CAP, and one attempt per run

perk_bans.doc: perks to keep BANNED while this run type plays, as fragments of the perk's own wording (numbers are ignored: 'coins, but tower max health'). Set on the Home Perks dialog before each entry when it differs from what was last applied. Unstated (null) never opens the dialog; [] clears every ban

policies.doc: which named policies this blueprint runs under

restart_via_home.doc: go back to the home screen between runs (where the between-run chores live) instead of straight to RETRY

shop_interval_sec.doc: how often the workshop sweep may run, in seconds

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

cycle_sec.doc: one cycle of the quest loop - seconds, greater than 0

reroll_at_wave.doc: reroll the quest at this wave

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

uw_setup.doc: which ultimate weapons the quest run switches on before it starts; a weapon the account does not own cannot be switched on

black_hole.doc: black hole on/off for the quest run

chain_lightning.doc: chain lightning on/off for the quest run

chronofield.doc: chronofield on/off for the quest run

death_wave.doc: death wave on/off for the quest run

golden_tower.doc: golden tower on/off for the quest run

inner_land_mines.doc: inner land mines on/off for the quest run

poison_swamp.doc: poison swamp on/off for the quest run

smart_missiles.doc: smart missiles on/off for the quest run

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

bar_names.doc: the two bars a rule can watch

after.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window opens; omit for 'from midnight'

block.doc: what the scheduler thinks it is launching (or any `quest*` name for the quest runners) - it is checked against the blueprint's kind

blueprint.doc: a key from this profile's `blueprints` section

count.doc: runs of this block per day, persisted per block id so an aborted day resumes. A tournament block is 1 and cannot be raised

until.doc: "HH:MM" local - the window closes; omit for 'rest of the day'. A block that runs past midnight belongs to both days, so write it in both

blueprint_fields.doc: the legal source fields of a blueprint, PER KIND - every field the validator accepts for that kind and no field it refuses

automation.doc: Per-run boolean routine gates; omitted gates retain existing defaults

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint once at run start - it LOCKS THE ABILITY ROW, so a rescue that needs abilities from wave 1 says so here

dissonant_tab.doc: Dissonance: enter runs via the Dissonant Run dialog with this workshop tab disabled, instead of the BATTLE button. Unstated (null) is a normal run. Shopping on the disabled tab is compiled out; ultimate_weapons also compiles the weapon toggles out. Needs the dialog images for that tab

global_behaviors.doc: Per-run reward settings overriding shared global behaviors

kind.doc: which runner drives this blueprint - it is also the key this section is grouped under

label.doc: what the tray and the run log call it; defaults to the blueprint name, title-cased

loadout.doc: a `config.yaml` loadouts key, or `as_is` to equip nothing (coin only). REQUIRED - an omitted loadout is a forgotten one, which is why it is refused

max_wave.doc: surrender at this wave, through the guarded exit flow. Unstated (null) is NO CAP, and one attempt per run

perk_bans.doc: perks to keep BANNED while this run type plays, as fragments of the perk's own wording (numbers are ignored: 'coins, but tower max health'). Set on the Home Perks dialog before each entry when it differs from what was last applied. Unstated (null) never opens the dialog; [] clears every ban

policies.doc: which named policies this blueprint runs under

restart_via_home.doc: go back to the home screen between runs (where the between-run chores live) instead of straight to RETRY

shop_interval_sec.doc: how often the workshop sweep may run, in seconds

tier.doc: REQUIRED on coin and shard (the runner sets it from the home screen). No upper bound: `player.max_tier` is only the highest tier seen unlocked (an advisory, never a refusal)

reroll_at_wave.doc: reroll the quest at this wave

uw_setup.doc: which ultimate weapons the quest run switches on before it starts; a weapon the account does not own cannot be switched on

black_hole.doc: black hole on/off for the quest run

chain_lightning.doc: chain lightning on/off for the quest run

chronofield.doc: chronofield on/off for the quest run

death_wave.doc: death wave on/off for the quest run

golden_tower.doc: golden tower on/off for the quest run

inner_land_mines.doc: inner land mines on/off for the quest run

poison_swamp.doc: poison swamp on/off for the quest run

smart_missiles.doc: smart missiles on/off for the quest run

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day

spotlight.doc: spotlight on/off for the quest run

buttons.doc: abilities the orchestrator owns taps for

chore_names.doc: the between-run chores (chores.py registry, priority order) a profile may switch off via policies.chores - an opt-out list: an unnamed chore stays enabled, an unknown name is refused

gather_keys.doc: policies.gather - what a run picks up between taps

ad_gem_options.doc: Ad-gem offer checks, retries and button inset

attempt_timeout_sec.doc: Stop attempts after this duration, or immediately after a confirmed claim. Farming continues between checks.

confirmed_cooldown_sec.doc: Time from the start of one collection window to the next, even when no gem is collected. Defaults to 12 minutes.

edge_inset_px.doc: Minimum distance from every button edge, including tap jitter and press drift.

poll_sec.doc: Random interval between checks for an ad-gem offer.

retry_cooldown_sec.doc: Random wait before checking again; a visible offer then gets its response delay.

ad_gems.doc: claim the HUD Ad Gems button

gem_delay_sec.doc: [low, high] whole seconds before the tap - it is splatted into random.uniform(), so both bounds are integers and low <= high

guild_store.doc: spend guild currency after collecting guild rewards (off by default)

in_run_action_kinds.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: tournament in_run_actions vocabulary (v1). One action kind, written flat as {at_wave: <wave>, switch_cards: <preset>}, at most 2 per blueprint, strictly ascending - and today only the EMPTY list is accepted

kinds.doc: blueprint kind - it picks the runner and decides which fields are legal

loadout_specials.doc: loadout values that are not a config.yaml loadouts key: `as_is` = equip nothing (coin blueprints only)

plan_tri_state.doc: the plan is a TRI-STATE: no `plan` section -> compile_plan() returns None, no CONFIG["plan"], and the scheduler runs its own constants; a plan with blocks -> the compiled week; a plan that resolves to no blocks -> refused at load, because a scheduler handed nothing either idles all day or falls back to constants the player thought they had replaced

burst.doc: the rescue burst: cancel the sprint, then fire

cancel_sprint.doc: end the intro sprint first (it locks the ability row); default true

require_match.doc: TIER A ONLY: refuse to tap when the ability glyph was not matched (default false - an unmatched glyph falls back to a fixed coordinate)

require_ready.doc: wait for the ability to be off cooldown (default false)

retaps.doc: extra taps off one frame - TIER A ONLY; refused on a main-loop rule, which confirms its own tap

cancel_sprint.doc: flag: {cancel_sprint: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

require_ready.doc: wait for cooldown; default false at main-loop latency

surrender_retry.doc: flag: {surrender_retry: true} - must be exactly true, because `false` is a rule with its action switched off and an evaluator that dispatched on the key would run it anyway

switch_cards.doc: PENDING VERIFIED ROUTE: apply a card preset mid-run. Offered so the editor shows the truth - a rule using it is REFUSED at load, because there is no verified route from a live battle to the cards screen and the runtime retires it on sight

preset.doc: a name from player.card_presets - account data, so the editor offers the profile's own list

toggle_uw.doc: switch one ultimate weapon on or off in the UW panel

want_on.doc: true = on, false = off; default true. NEVER write this key as `on` - YAML 1.1 eats the word

bar.doc: a bar under a threshold: {bar: wall, below: 0.02}
which bar

below.doc: fire under this level - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

deadband.doc: ignore drops smaller than this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

falling_samples.doc: consecutive falling samples required first (unstated = 0: the level alone decides)

fleet_mark.doc: the waves around a fleet mark

after_waves.doc: waves after the mark to start

window_waves.doc: how many waves the window lasts

second_wind.doc: the Second Wind proc, by state

min_procs.doc: procs required this run so far

wall_collapse.doc: the wall falling FROM above a level, i.e. a collapse rather than a slow decline

from_above.doc: it must have been above this - a fraction of the bar, 0..1 - NOT a percentage

shop_modes.doc: how a directive spends: repeat until unaffordable, once, cheapest-first, or a fixed number of clicks

shop_stats.doc: stats the sweep can actually FIND on screen - derived from templates/stats/*.png, because a stat with no template compiles fine and is then silently unbuyable for the whole run

sw_states.doc: Second Wind states the RunState can already answer

uw_names.doc: every ultimate weapon in the game - editors list ALL of them (2026-08-29, user ruling): presets may name any UW; player.uws ownership only decides what applies on an account

weekdays.doc: plan.week keys, in datetime.weekday() order. Full names only - `mon`/`0` are refused, so a profile cannot carry two spellings of one day
